"""Build next-trading-day weekly labels and genuinely available market features."""
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from study import *
from backtest.market_style.data import expand_features

FACTORS=['small_big','lowvol_highvol','momentum']
PROBE_DATES=['2007-05-31','2015-07-09','2020-07-31','2024-02-05','2026-07-23']

def prefixes(prices,volume,days):
    """Revalue aged cohorts at the current close; form baskets on historical snapshots."""
    assert days.is_unique and prices.index.equals(volume.index)
    i=prices.index.get_indexer(days)
    assert i.min()>=26 and np.all(i[1:]==i[:-1]+1)
    blocks=[]
    for ids in np.array_split(i,(len(i)+119)//120):
        first,last=ids[0]-29,ids[-1]
        price=prices.iloc[first:last+1]
        amount=volume.iloc[first:last+1]
        ret=price.pct_change(fill_method=None).where(amount>0)
        factors={'small_big':np.log1p(amount.rolling(20).mean()),'lowvol_highvol':ret.rolling(20).std(),'momentum':price/price.shift(20)-1}
        rows={}
        sub_ix=prices.index[ids]
        for fac,values in factors.items():
            ranks=values.rank(axis=1,pct=True,method='average')
            low,high=ranks.le(.3),ranks.ge(.7)
            long,short=(high,low) if fac=='momentum' else (low,high)
            for age in range(2,7):
                entry=price.shift(age-1)
                pnl=(price/entry-1).where((amount>0)&(amount.shift(age-1)>0)).loc[sub_ix]
                l=long.shift(age,fill_value=False).loc[sub_ix]
                s=short.shift(age,fill_value=False).loc[sub_ix]
                rows[f'fixed_{fac}_age{age}']=pnl.where(l).mean(axis=1)-pnl.where(s).mean(axis=1)
        blocks.append(pd.DataFrame(rows,index=sub_ix))
    return pd.concat(blocks)

def new_features(x,market,cal,quotes,periods,paths):
    idx=x.index
    loc=cal.get_indexer(idx)
    nxt=cal[loc+1]
    wk=idx.to_period('W-FRI')
    data=pd.DataFrame(index=idx)
    data['next_week_boundary']=(wk!=nxt.to_period('W-FRI')).astype(int)
    data['target_weekday']=nxt.dayofweek
    data['week_elapsed_sessions']=pd.Series(np.ones(len(idx)),index=idx).groupby(wk).cumsum()
    recent=market.loc[idx]
    for k in ['mkt',*FACTORS]:
        data['week_sum_'+k]=recent[k].groupby(wk).cumsum()
    data['week_max_drawdown_from_close']=((1+recent.mkt).groupby(wk).cumprod()/((1+recent.mkt).groupby(wk).cumprod().groupby(wk).cummax())-1)
    resolved=quotes.set_index('exit_h5')[[k+'_h5' for k in FACTORS]].sort_index()
    assert resolved.index.is_unique
    for k in FACTORS:
        for n in [1,5,20]:
            data[f'mature_{k}_mean{n}']=resolved[k+'_h5'].rolling(n).mean().reindex(idx)
        # Fully mature cohort at age six matches realization directly from archived endpoints.
        np.testing.assert_allclose(paths['fixed_'+k+'_age6'],data['mature_'+k+'_mean1'],rtol=0,atol=1.5e-7)
    historical=periods.set_index('ready_date').sort_index()
    assert historical.index.is_unique
    prev_idx=historical.index.get_indexer(idx,method='ffill')
    assert min(prev_idx)>=0
    prev=historical.iloc[prev_idx]
    assert (prev.index<=idx).all()
    data['mature_weeks_age_sessions']=loc-cal.get_indexer(prev.index)
    for k in ['mkt','mkt_vol',*FACTORS]:data['mature_week_'+k]=prev[k].to_numpy()
    for k in FACTORS:
        for age in range(2,6):data[f'fixed_{k}_age{age}']=paths[f'fixed_{k}_age{age}']
        same=[]
        for age in range(2,6):
            mask=cal[loc-age].to_period('W-FRI')==nxt.to_period('W-FRI')
            same.append(paths[f'fixed_{k}_age{age}'].where(mask))
        data['partial_target_week_'+k]=pd.concat(same,axis=1).mean(axis=1)
    return data,prev

def run():
    assert checked()['status']=='active'
    config=read(CONTRACT)
    for x in config['inputs']:
        assert fp(ROOT/x['path'])==x
    original=OLDCLASS/'data/features.parquet'
    manifest=read(OLDCLASS/'configs/feature-manifest.json')
    assert fp(original)['sha256']==manifest['dataset_files']['features']['sha256']
    x=pd.read_parquet(original)
    market=pd.read_parquet(OLDCLASS/'data/daily-market.parquet')
    idxprices=pd.read_parquet(OLDCLASS/'data/index-prices.parquet')
    cal=pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(CAL.read_text().splitlines()))
    calendar_dates=cal[(cal>='2004-01-02')&(cal<='2026-07-31')]
    assert x.index.equals(calendar_dates)
    week_dates=pd.read_csv(WEEK/'data/date-labels.csv',index_col='datetime',parse_dates=['datetime','ready_date'])
    periods=pd.read_csv(WEEK/'data/period-labels.csv',parse_dates=['first','last','ready_date'])
    quote_dir=PREV/'data/quotes'
    quotes=pd.read_parquet(quote_dir/'forward.parquet')
    with np.load(quote_dir/'effective-quotes.npz',allow_pickle=False) as z:
        px=pd.DataFrame(z['close'],index=pd.DatetimeIndex(z['calendar']),columns=z['symbols'])
        amount=pd.DataFrame(z['amount'],index=px.index,columns=px.columns)
    path=prefixes(px,amount,x.index)
    extra,prev=new_features(x,market,cal,quotes,periods,path)
    feature=pd.concat([x,extra],axis=1)
    assert not feature.columns.has_duplicates and not np.isinf(feature.to_numpy(dtype=float)).any()
    full_probe=[]
    for ds in PROBE_DATES:
        t=pd.Timestamp(ds)
        dates=x.loc[:t].index
        path_t=prefixes(px.loc[:t],amount.loc[:t],dates[-1:])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(path_t.to_numpy(),path.loc[[t]].to_numpy(),rtol=0,atol=2e-8)
        actual,_=new_features(x.loc[:t],market.loc[:t],cal,quotes[quotes.exit_h5<=t],periods[periods.ready_date<=t],path.loc[:t])
        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual.iloc[[-1]],extra.loc[[t]],check_freq=False)
        recomputed,_=expand_features(market.loc[:t],idxprices.loc[:t])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(recomputed.loc[t,x.columns].to_numpy(dtype=float),x.loc[t].to_numpy(dtype=float),rtol=2e-6,atol=3e-7,equal_nan=True)
        full_probe.append(ds)
    nxt=cal[cal.get_indexer(x.index)+1]
    label=week_dates.loc[nxt]
    targets=pd.DataFrame({'target_date':nxt,'label':label.style4.to_numpy(),'period':label.period.to_numpy(),'ready_date':label.ready_date.to_numpy(),'last_matured_class':prev.style4.to_numpy(),'last_matured_ready':prev.index,'first_target_of_week':(x.index.to_period('W-FRI')!=nxt.to_period('W-FRI'))},index=x.index)
    assert (targets.ready_date>targets.target_date).all() and (targets.last_matured_ready<=targets.index).all()
    train=((targets.index>='2004-01-02')&(targets.index<='2020-07-31')&(targets.target_date<='2020-07-31')&(targets.ready_date<='2020-07-31'))
    test=((targets.index>='2020-08-03')&(targets.target_date<='2026-07-31'))
    targets['segment']=np.select([train,test],['train','eval'],default='excluded')
    assert sum(test)==1453 and set(targets.label[train])==set(NAMES)
    newnames=list(extra.columns)
    meta={'core_features':manifest['core_features']+newnames,'full_features':list(feature.columns),'new_features':newnames,'source':fp(original),'feature_information_cutoff':'Signal-day mainland market close; quote membership at t-age, entry t-age+1, partial return exits at t. Full H5 and weekly features as-of actual maturity date. Next scheduled trade date is calendar-only.'}
    for n,f in [('features',feature),('targets',targets)]:f.to_parquet(CLASS/'data'/f'{n}.parquet')
    write(CLASS/'configs/feature-manifest.json',meta)
    def describe(mask):
        days=targets[mask]
        return {'n_days':len(days),'signal_start':str(days.index[0].date()),'signal_end':str(days.index[-1].date()),'target_start':str(days.target_date.min().date()),'target_end':str(days.target_date.max().date()),'last_label_ready':str(days.ready_date.max().date()),'days_by_class':{k:int(days.label.eq(k).sum()) for k in NAMES},'weeks_by_class':{k:int(days.loc[days.label.eq(k),'period'].nunique()) for k in NAMES}}
    proof={'features':fp(CLASS/'data/features.parquet'),'targets':fp(CLASS/'data/targets.parquet'),'manifest':fp(CLASS/'configs/feature-manifest.json'),'frozen_partition':fp(WEEK/'data/date-labels.csv'),'train':describe(train),'eval':describe(test),'original_nfeatures':x.shape[1],'derived_nfeatures':extra.shape[1],'core_nfeatures':len(meta['core_features']),'source_asof_reconstruction_probes':full_probe,'exit_after_evaluation_end':int((targets.ready_date[test]>'2026-07-31').sum()),'train_excluded_immature_signal_dates':[str(d.date()) for d in targets.index[(targets.index<='2020-07-31')&~train]],'external_inputs':'The original 6 external probes lack verified historic publication time and were not used.'}
    write(CLASS/'docs/input-audit.json',proof)
    print(proof['train'],proof['eval'],flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':run()
